name: Nindo: Always Save Who I can

system.description: This Nindo is one of healing. When you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that restores an allied creatures, excluding yourself, hit points, you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Saved, for the next minute. A Saved creature that gains ranks of a condition from a hostile effect, reduced the ranks they would gain by 1, losing the Saved mark.

source.custom: Source Markdown line 7778; contextual rules require adjudication.
